page.notes: The page is cut off on the right side; the text of the right-hand part of the lines is not visible. Some marks such as the "vindicatur" and "conciliatur" words may be partly cropped. Doubtful: "cap.24.v.17.19.&20." and "dæos" (possibly "dæos" for Dæos) are uncertain. The leftmost header "I" and the "N" in the header are as seen; the top-right edge is cut off, so the readings of the first line are uncertain. Some numbers at the left edge are faint. Page number not printed on this part. Some numbers are uncertain at the scan's edge; "186" in cap. 9 v. 3 may be "186" or "180". Greek/Latin markings in the margin dots are not text.
